name: Obtenebration (Dark Ages) — Intermediate — Arms of Ahriman

system.description: You can call forth tentacles of darkness from the shadows and bid them to grip people, strike them, or perform tasks of dexterity. Expend a single Blood Trait to awaken the shadows, and one Social Trait per tentacle you wish to create. Tentacles issue from any nearby source of shadow and have a reach of six feet. Each tentacle possesses three Physical Traits and three health levels. For each additional Blood Trait spent, you can increase a single tentacle's length by six feet or grant it one extra Physical Trait. Tentacles can be damaged normally, and are injured by fire and sunlight — they benefit from any Fortitude you have, or alternatively you can add your Potence to any tentacles (removing their Fortitude benefit). Arms of Ahriman last for one scene, until you lose consciousness, or until you dispel them.
system.bloodCost: 1 Blood Trait plus 1 Social Trait per tentacle
